parameters.query: WITH streak_calc AS (SELECT c.user_id, u.email, p.profile->>'name' as name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (c.data->'workouts'->>'a')::boolean OR (c.data->'workouts'->>'b')::boolean OR (c.data->'workouts'->>'c')::boolean OR (c.data->'workouts'->>'d')::boolean) as sessions_this_week, c.weight as latest_weight FROM public.checkins c JOIN auth.users u ON c.user_id = u.id JOIN public.user_profiles p ON c.user_id = p.user_id WHERE c.date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY c.user_id, u.email, p.profile) SELECT *, CASE WHEN sessions_this_week >= 4 THEN 'on_track' WHEN sessions_this_week >= 2 THEN 'partial' ELSE 'missed' END as week_status FROM streak_calc
